subs.text: Hazards ahead. Opportunities, also ahead. Mostly hazards.
Lancer Gate. Crossfire. Lancers fire across the lane, never along it.
Almost as if they were keeping the lane itself clear. Odd.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
Your first live lock! Intel filed. Every scan helps the Authority map its lanes.

A disarm. That is forty percent.
I am sure you had a reason, and I am sure it was a good one.

If you see unarmed ships in the lanes, please ignore them.
Wonderful. If you could do that all the time, that would be ideal.
